verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms Obsidian stores notes as Markdown plain text (headings, code blocks implied) and supports linking, mobile toolbar for editing, a Command Palette, and Vim mode compatibility (comm-1, docs-34), suggesting keyboard-driven workflows. However, no direct documentation addresses callouts, tables, or embedded media support, and there's no explicit performance/speed claim for the editor. Missing for 10: explicit docs on callouts, table syntax, embedded media (images/PDF/audio), and hands-on evidence of editor speed/responsiveness for power users.
